## Highlights

**Flashwatch 2.1 misses far fewer enemy spells.**

- **Fixed: every Flash missed when the game and Flashwatch spoke different
  languages.** A French client with Flashwatch set to English printed "Saut
  éclair" to a reader that only knew "Flash", and only spells whose names look
  alike in both languages got through. Spell names are now recognised in every
  language Flashwatch speaks, whatever the language setting.
- **Sharper chat reading.** Chat lines are now read in colour, at the size the
  text recogniser expects. Red champion names no longer come out mangled
  ("Sarer used Fash" for "Garen used Flash"), two chat lines that touch are read
  as two instead of one unreadable line, and a line whose author's colon was
  lost or misread is no longer thrown away.
- **New: the death recap.** When you die, an enemy's Ignite or Smite shown in
  the panel at the top left starts its timer, unless one is already running.
  The panel does not say when the spell was cast, so the timer counts from the
  start of the fight and carries a "?": it can end a little early, never late.
  A ping in chat confirms it. It can be switched off in *Settings*.
- **The countdown now sits on the bottom edge of each spell icon** in the
  enemy-team display, so you can still see which spell is down. The old look is
  one switch away in *Display*.
- **Old timers go away with the old game** as soon as the clock at the top of
  the screen shows a new one, even when the game's data feed is not answering.
